faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU is 22nd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech in Chemical/Mechanical Engineering with a CGPA/CPI of 7.0 (on a scale of 10) or an M.Sc. in Chemistry or Physics with basic knowledge of electrochemistry.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for female, SC, ST, OBC, and physically handicapped candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month, plus Rs. 7,400 as HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is RISE/SA/MoM/CHE/26-27/911.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT BHU located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Banaras Hindu University (IIT BHU) is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.
